<style>
/*width*/
.streamline_list::-webkit-scrollbar {
height:4px;
}
/*track*/
.streamline_list::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
background:var(--brand-colors-blue-tints--80);
border-width:1px;
border-style:none;
margin:5rem;
}

/*Tablet Scrollbar Margin*/
@media only screen and (max-width: 991px) {
.streamline_list::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
margin:3rem;
}
/*Mobile Scrollbar Margin*/
@media only screen and (max-width: 767px) {
.streamline_list::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
margin:1.5rem;
}

/*thumb*/
.streamline_list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
background:var(--brand-colors--blue);
}
</style>

<style>

.swiper-pagination.review-swiper {
  position: relative;
  left: 0 !important;
  top: 0 !important; 
  bottom: 0 !important;
  display: flex;
  width: auto !important;  
}

.swiper-pagination.review-swiper .swiper-pagination-bullet {
	width: 0.75rem;
  height: 0.75rem;
  background: white;
  opacity: .5;
  transition: opacity 0.35s ease;
}

.swiper-pagination.review-swiper .swiper-pagination-bullet.swiper-pagination-bullet-active {	
  background: white !important; 
  opacity: 1;
}

.swiper-slide.review-thumbs.swiper-slide-thumb-active .review_card-thumbs{
	border-top-color: var(--white);
}
</style>
